questions.prompt: What does Windows do to keep an SSD fast?
questions.explanation: TRIM tells the SSD which blocks are no longer in use.

questions.prompt: Match the backup rule numbers to their meaning.
questions.explanation: 3-2-1 protects against drive failure, theft, fire and ransomware.

questions.prompt: A customer has two antivirus programs running in real time. What should you advise?
questions.explanation: Two real-time scanners conflict and slow the computer.

questions.prompt: A disk health tool shows a growing number of reallocated sectors on an HDD. What does it mean?
choices: The drive is starting to fail: back up and plan a replacement
questions.explanation: Reallocated sectors are a classic early warning of HDD failure.

questions.prompt: Which tasks belong in regular software maintenance? Select all that apply.
choices: Opening the PSU to clean it
